title: Dolly Dream House
description:
The Dolly Dream House Airbnb is a Nashville vibe! Featuring Dolly Parton, Taylor Swift, Johnny Cash & Music City. 4 Bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, sleeps 12 with brand new QUEEN tempur-pedic beds, HUGE living and dining room that comfortably seat 12 or more guests. Gorgeous outdoor screened in deck to watch the deer graze the lawn. ONE MILE FROM THE LAKE and 20 minutes from downtown NASHVILLE! This is the perfect bachelorette party, girls getaway, vacation destination, birthday parties and more!

The space
Dolly room features a life size cut out of Dolly Parton for selfies, queen tempra-pedic bed plus a fold out sofa sleeper and full bathroom en-suite. The Taylor Swift room features a life size Taylor Swift with real hair for selfies and queen tempra-pedic bed along with a lighted makeup vanity for getting all dolled up. The Nashville room has a queen tempra-pedic bed and lighted makeup vanity and lots of space. The Johnny Cash room has queen over twin XL beds for extra large sleeping area. The living room has a fold out sleeper sofa for additional sleeping space. There are selfie spots all over the home and don’t forget to enjoy the screen in deck to watch the sunset. Full kitchen, laundry room and all amenities needed for your stay. Coffee maker, glitter refrigerator, toaster, over and cooktop, dishes and more! This is a dream destination.
